headlines.title: Chipotle removes jalapeños after possible link to salmonella outbreak
headlines.description: Chipotle said Tuesday it had removed jalapeños from its restaurants across the country after they were suspected in a salmonella outbreak that has sickened at least 110 people in Minnesota.

headlines.title: How to Tell if You Have a Healthy Gut (and What to Do if You Don't)
headlines.description: Gut health can impact everything from sleep to the immune system, so Dr. Roshini Raj, associate professor of medicine at NYU Langone Health, shares her recommendations for preserving your gut microbiome. She shares the signs of an unhealthy gut, and what to eat to improve it. Dr. Raj also shares her tips for avoiding cyclosporiasis.

headlines.title: How to Treat Summer Skin Problems, According to a Dermatologist
headlines.description: Summer heat, humidity and sweat can really change the way skin looks and feels. Board-certified dermatologist Dr. Michelle Henry joins TODAY with different treatments for the most common skin concerns such as dehydration, acne, melasma and more.

headlines.title: Two Deaths Linked to Cyclosporiasis Outbreak in Michigan
headlines.description: Health officials in Michigan have confirmed the first two deaths related to cyclosporiasis in the United States. It comes as the CDC and FDA continue to investigate the multi-state outbreak of the parasite they've linked to contaminated iceberg lettuce. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: First deaths from lettuce-linked outbreak
headlines.description: The dangerous illness linked to lettuce has now turned deadly, with two people reported dead in Michigan. In North Carolina, officials say recent cases reported eating parsley and cilantro. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports.

headlines.title: The best acne treatments for your scalp and hairline
headlines.description: We asked dermatologists for their picks of the best scalp acne shampoos and treatments from Differin, Dove, Neutrogena and more.

headlines.title: All the glow, none of the grease — the best hyaluronic acid products
headlines.description: Dermatologists share the best hyaluronic acid serums and creams to hydrate, plump and smooth your skin from brands like CeraVe and The Ordinary.

headlines.title: These stackable storage bins are 40% off for a limited time — they’re dorm room and small apartment ready
headlines.description: Save 40% on these bestselling stackable storage bins at Amazon. The easy-to-assemble organizers are ideal for maximizing space in closets, dorm rooms, offices and more.

headlines.title: Derm-approved skin care to soothe rosacea and redness
headlines.description: Dermatologists share the best skin care products for rosacea and redness relief in 2026, from Aveeno, EltaMD, CeraVe and more.

headlines.title: Michigan reports first two deaths in the cyclosporiasis outbreak
headlines.description: More than 11,000 cases of the foodborne illness have been confirmed in the state and 193 people have been hospitalized since early May.

headlines.title: Nicole ‘Snooki’ Polizzi reveals hysterectomy after cervical cancer diagnosis
headlines.description: An emotional Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi announced on Friday that she underwent a hysterectomy operation to treat Stage 1 cervical cancer, months after first disclosing her diagnosis.

headlines.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment right not to testify at Covid hearing
headlines.description: In his opening statement, the former top health official accused Sen. Rand Paul of having an “unhinged obsession” with him and wanting him put “behind bars.”
